item_short_desc: Stay comfortable during chilly days with Rothco’s G.I. Wool Scarf. Crafted from 100% wool, this scarf offers exceptional warmth and comfort to keep you snug during winter. Made in the U.S.A., it boasts a double-layer construction for unbeatable insulation against the cold. Measuring 56 inches long by 9 inches wide, it provides ample coverage to keep you protected. Whether you're commuting to work or enjoying outdoor activities, this scarf is the perfect accessory to tackle the cold.
